  - main:
    - text: CLASS 12 · FORMAL CALCULUS
    - heading "Definite Integral Properties" [level=1]
    - paragraph: Definite integrals represent signed area. Explore interval changes, reversal, and symmetry.
    - navigation:
      - radio "Composer" [checked]
      - text: Composer
      - radio "Properties"
      - text: Properties
      - radio "Worked Example"
      - text: Worked Example
      - radio "Practice"
      - text: Practice
    - heading "SIGNED-AREA INTERVAL COMPOSER" [level=3]
    - text: Function f(x)=x Interval [0,4] Split point c
    - status "Split point c 2": "2.00"
    - slider "Split point c": "2"
    - img "Signed area interval graph": c=2 y=x
    - article:
      - text: Left interval [0,c]
      - heading "∫₀ᶜ x dx = 2.00" [level=2]
    - article:
      - text: Right interval [c,4]
      - heading "∫ᶜ⁴ x dx = 6.00" [level=2]
    - article:
      - text: Total interval [0,4]
      - heading "∫₀⁴ x dx = 8.00" [level=2]
    - heading "∫₀⁴x dx = ∫₀ᶜx dx + ∫ᶜ⁴x dx = 2.00 + 6.00 = 8.00" [level=2]
    - complementary:
      - text: Definite integrals measure signed area, not total geometric area.
      - paragraph: Areas below the x-axis count as negative. For total area, use ∫|f(x)|dx.
    - heading "DEFINITE INTEGRAL PROPERTIES" [level=3]
    - article:
      - text: 1 Zero-width interval
      - heading "∫ₐᵃf(x)dx=0" [level=2]
      - paragraph: An interval with no width has no area.
    - article:
      - text: 2 Additivity
      - heading "∫ₐᵇf=∫ₐᶜf+∫ᶜᵇf" [level=2]
      - paragraph: Split an interval without changing the total.
    - article:
      - text: 3 Reversal of limits
      - heading "∫ₐᵇf=−∫ᵦᵃf" [level=2]
      - paragraph: Reverse bounds and reverse the sign.
    - article:
      - text: 4 Constant multiple
      - heading "∫ₐᵇkf=k∫ₐᵇf" [level=2]
      - paragraph: Constants factor outside an integral.
    - article:
      - text: 5 Even function symmetry
      - heading "∫₋ₐᵃf=2∫₀ᵃf" [level=2]
      - paragraph: Even functions mirror equal areas.
    - article:
      - text: 6 Odd function symmetry
      - heading "∫₋ₐᵃf=0" [level=2]
      - paragraph: Odd functions cancel symmetric signed areas.
    - article:
      - heading "WORKED EXAMPLE" [level=3]:
        - img
        - text: WORKED EXAMPLE
      - paragraph: "Using additivity with c=2:"
      - heading "∫₁⁴x dx = ∫₁²x dx + ∫₂⁴x dx = 3/2 + 6 = 15/2 = 7.5" [level=2]
